text: {"name":"ipc_msg_dispatch","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Dispatches the current kernel/IPC message through its handler, allocates and links an IPC message descriptor, appends it to the host message queue under an IRQ-locked critical section, and rings the doorbell, freeing the message if descriptor allocation fails.","subsystem":"ipc","var_renames":{"v1":"msg","v2":"msg_node","v3":"msg_node","v4":"msg_offset_ptr","v5":"msg_offset","v6":"ipc_lock_cnt","v7":"ipc_host_status","v8":"prev_lock_cnt","v9":"ipc_tx_queue_ctrl","v10":"queue_count_prev","v11":"msg_count_prev","v12":"ipc_doorbell","v13":"new_lock_cnt","v14":"irq_disabled_flag","v15":"ipc_tx_queue_tail"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"message descriptor payload pointer (original message plus data offset)"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"next pointer for linked IPC message descriptor"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"reserved/zeroed descriptor field"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"tail pointer field in IPC tx queue control"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"16-bit message queue count field in IPC tx queue control"}]}
